limitations: The theorem concerns the ambient subspace metric on the deleted-ball complement. The cubic coefficient itself is not identified and optimality of the cubic remainder is not claimed. Full text of the very recent Schott preprint could not be obtained through the attempted lawful routes; its abstract and the exact theorem statement cited in the record were compared, so source-version wording remains a residual risk.
record_title: Universal cubic-error Gromov--Hausdorff asymptotic for a deleted geodesic ball
